# Complete interface graph beside marker delegation

Core<T> implements View<T>, whose Root<T> parent retains the same invariant
Object-bounded formal. The private typed constructor and raw public marker entry
keep their original input references and wide words. Frozen callers audit both
interface edges, constructor Signatures, callbacks, partial fields, nulls,
marker identity and failures. Only the reported marker synthetic flag changes;
all other original entries and compiler metadata are audited. Four independently
compiled wrong programs must fail across 48 cases per owned/SDK configuration.
